_note: Per metric: exact (no difference), absolute (|a-b| <= value) or relative (|a-b| <= value * |b|). The values hold the UI's own rounding (CTR to 0.1 point, position to 0.1, money to the cent). "page": "optional" marks a metric the page leaves blank in its total row (Ads Report Editor does): a missing page value does not leave the week incomplete.
